items.title: Utmost Good Faith (Uberrima Fides)
items.description: Both the insurer and the insured must transparently disclose all material facts correctly. Non-disclosure can make the contract void.

items.title: Insurable Interest
items.description: The policyholder must suffer a direct financial loss if the insured event occurs. You cannot buy life insurance for a stranger.

items.title: Indemnity
items.description: Insurance is meant to compensate you for the exact loss incurred, putting you back in the same financial position. (Note: Does not strictly apply to Life Insurance).

items.title: Subrogation
items.description: The legal right of the insurer to recover the amount of loss from a responsible third party after settling the claim with the insured.

items.title: Proximate Cause (Causa Proxima)
items.description: When multiple causes lead to a loss, the insurer only pays if the most active, direct, and efficient cause is covered by the policy.
